name: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B
released_note: HF repo for the 24GB pack created 2026-10-07; the BF16 repo 2026-10-09; Unsloth and Ollama 2026-10-14/15.

architecture.layer_mix: Mamba-2 + Transformer hybrid LatentMoE with a C-RADIO v4-H vision encoder
architecture.anatomy: Compressed from Nemotron 3.5 Super and further trained (NVIDIA). The 24GB pack stores experts at 2 bits (QAD), 24.1 GB on disk.

summary: NVIDIA's local agent model: 74B total, 9B active, vision, 256K context. NVIDIA ships a 24 GB pack with 2-bit experts recovered by quantisation-aware distillation, and names RTX 5090, DGX Spark and RTX Spark as targets. Ollama's tag is 25 GB; not supported on Apple Silicon yet.

practical_baseline.reason: No reported or measured run recorded yet.
